attchmntText: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Scrutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited announces that the Ordinary resolution to approve material related party transactions with Leela BKC Holdings Private Limited for construction and other purposes has been passed by shareholders. The resolution was approved via remote e-voting postal ballot conducted between October 17, 2026, and November 15, 2026. The scrutinizer, Komal Shrimankar of BMP & Co. LLP, confirmed the results. A total of 45,214,195 votes were cast in favor, representing 99.9978 percent of valid votes polled, while 994 votes were cast against, representing 0.0022 percent. The voting results and the scrutinizer's report are available on the company website.
